definitionEn: To support someone; or to make a copy of data.

examples.sentence: I will back you up in the discussion.
Back up your files every week.

definitionEn: To fill something with air; or to explode.

examples.sentence: Don't blow up the balloon too much.

definitionEn: To stop working; or to lose control of your emotions.

examples.sentence: Our bus broke down on the way to school.

definitionEn: To mention a topic; or to raise a child.

examples.sentence: She brought up an interesting idea at the meeting.
examples.translation: Toplantıda ilginç bir fikir ortaya attı.

definitionEn: To cancel a planned event.

examples.sentence: They called off the match because of rain.

definitionEn: To continue doing something.

examples.sentence: Carry on with your work.

definitionEn: To reach the same level as others after being behind.

examples.sentence: I must catch up on my lessons after the holiday.

definitionEn: To look at something with interest; or to leave a hotel.

examples.sentence: Check out this new learning app.
examples.translation: Bu yeni öğrenme uygulamasına göz at.

definitionEn: To meet or find something by chance.

examples.sentence: I came across an old photo yesterday.

definitionEn: To think of an idea or solution.

examples.sentence: He came up with a great solution.

definitionEn: To trust someone to do something.

examples.sentence: You can always count on your true friends.

definitionEn: To stop the supply of something.

examples.sentence: The storm cut off the electricity.

definitionEn: To handle or manage a problem.

examples.sentence: We must learn to deal with stress.

definitionEn: To wear formal or special clothes.

examples.sentence: We dressed up for the wedding.

definitionEn: To understand or solve something.

examples.sentence: I can't figure out this math problem.

definitionEn: To write information in a form or document.

examples.sentence: Please fill in your name and address.

definitionEn: To learn information about something.

examples.sentence: I just found out that the trip is free.

definitionEn: To have a good relationship with someone.

examples.sentence: She gets along with all her classmates.

definitionEn: To recover from an illness or a bad feeling.

examples.sentence: It took him two weeks to get over the flu.

definitionEn: To stop trying to do something.

examples.sentence: Don't give up when things become difficult.

definitionEn: To continue happening or doing something.

examples.sentence: The concert went on despite the rain.

definitionEn: To change from a child into an adult.

examples.sentence: He grew up in a small village.

definitionEn: To spend time with friends in a relaxed way.

examples.sentence: We usually hang out at the park.

definitionEn: To wait for a short time.

examples.sentence: Hold on, I will be ready in five minutes.

definitionEn: To stay at the same level as others.

examples.sentence: It is hard to keep up with new technology.

definitionEn: To take care of someone or something.

examples.sentence: She looks after her little brother.

definitionEn: To feel excited about something in the future.

examples.sentence: I look forward to the summer holiday.

definitionEn: To search for information in a book or online.

examples.sentence: If you don't know a word, look it up.

definitionEn: To lift something; or to learn something easily.

examples.sentence: He picked up English by watching films.

definitionEn: To delay something to a later time.

examples.sentence: Don't put off your homework until midnight.

definitionEn: To have none of something left.

examples.sentence: We ran out of milk this morning.

definitionEn: To start or arrange something new.

examples.sentence: They set up a new study group.

definitionEn: To arrive or appear somewhere.

examples.sentence: Everyone showed up on time.

definitionEn: To look or behave like a family member.

examples.sentence: She takes after her mother.

definitionEn: To put something in the rubbish.

examples.sentence: Don't throw away plastic bottles.

definitionEn: To refuse an offer; or to lower the volume.

examples.sentence: She turned down the job offer.

definitionEn: To stop a machine by pressing a switch or button.

examples.sentence: Please turn off the lights.

definitionEn: To start a machine by pressing a switch or button.

examples.sentence: Can you turn on the TV?

definitionEn: To stop sleeping.

examples.sentence: I wake up at seven every morning.

definitionEn: To exercise; or to develop in a good way.

examples.sentence: He works out three times a week.
